articles.headline: France luxury stores board up windows for protests
articles.brief: Luxury retailers across France are boarding up their display windows as authorities prepare for a fresh wave of nationwide demonstrations and potential civil unrest.

articles.headline: India Scotch probe threatens trade pact benefits
articles.brief: A trade group warns that India's ongoing investigation into Scotch whisky producers Diageo and Pernod Ricard could undermine the mutual benefits of the budding India-UK trade pact.

articles.headline: North Korea's Kim Jong Un visits China
articles.brief: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has crossed the border into China via the Dandong bridge, according to a senior South Korean official tracking regional diplomatic movements.

articles.headline: Magnitude 7.2 earthquake strikes near Vanuatu
articles.brief: A powerful magnitude 7.2 earthquake has struck off the coast in the waters near Vanuatu, prompting brief regional tsunami monitoring by international seismic agencies.

articles.headline: Ambani's Jio IPO draws record seventy billion
articles.brief: Reliance's Jio has secured massive investor backing, becoming India's most subscribed initial public offering with an unprecedented seventy-seven billion dollars in bids.

articles.headline: Amazon cloud capacity entirely sold out through 2027
articles.brief: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy announced that the company's cloud computing capacity is completely sold out through 2027, driven by intense enterprise demand for data infrastructure.

articles.headline: US telecom shares wobble over SpaceX cellular plans
articles.brief: Major American telecommunication operators saw stock volatility following reports that SpaceX is actively in advanced talks regarding direct-to-cell satellite coverage sites.

articles.headline: Seven killed in terror attack at Jordan church
articles.brief: Authorities in Jordan report that at least seven people have been killed after armed gunmen opened fire inside a church during what is being classified as a terrorist attack.

articles.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree to localized ceasefire
articles.brief: In a surprise development, Russian and Ukrainian officials have agreed to a ceasefire in one embattled town and planned formal peace talks for next month.

articles.headline: Kerala SMA drug controversy sparks political debate
articles.brief: Parents of children suffering from spinal muscular atrophy are protesting a government shift from branded to generic programs, drawing intense political engagement in Kerala.

articles.headline: India beats target with 11 crore farmer IDs
articles.brief: The central government has successfully issued eleven crore unique farmer identification cards under the AgriStack initiative, beating its initial March 2027 deadline.

articles.headline: IRGC claims operational control of Strait of Hormuz
articles.brief: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has claimed full control over the Strait of Hormuz, issuing stern warnings against any US warships entering the Persian Gulf.

articles.headline: Four Philippine Air Force pilots die in crash
articles.brief: Four pilots belonging to the Philippine Air Force have tragically lost their lives during a routine training flight accident, military authorities confirmed.

articles.headline: New York charity trains thousands of physicians
articles.brief: Founded by grieving parents after a tragic hospital loss, the R Baby Foundation has successfully trained over 6,500 physicians in emergency pediatric medical care.
